results.title: Israeli strikes in Gaza kill eight including child, hospitals say
results.content: Israeli strikes in Gaza have killed at least eight people, including a child, according to hospitals, despite a year-old ceasefire.

results.title: NPP opens applications for 2028 parliamentary primaries, sets GH¢5,000 fee
results.content: The New Patriotic Party (NPP) has opened applications for prospective parliamentary candidates seeking to contest its parliamentary primaries ahead of the 2028 General Elections.

results.title: Armed police start patrols in Sydney after Bondi Beach attack
results.content: Heavily-armed police officers have started patrolling Sydney's streets, as part of heightened security measures following last year's deadly shooting at Bondi Beach.

results.title: National Service Authority sets November 2 for military training screening
results.content: The National Service Authority (NSA) has announced that screening and medical examinations for preselected National Service Personnel (NSPs) who expressed interest in participating in the Basic Military Training Programme will begin on Monday, November 2, 2026.

results.title: Two Techiman SHS teachers arrested over alleged assault of 17-year-old student
results.content: The Bono East Regional Police Command has arrested two teachers of Techiman Senior High School (SHS) following the circulation of a viral video allegedly showing them assaulting a 17-year-old male student.

results.title: Upper West GJA Awards: Stakeholders call for improved media welfare, ethical standards
results.content: The second edition of the Upper West Regional Ghana Journalists Association (GJA) Awards concluded in Wa with a resounding call from media leaders, traditional rulers and corporate partners to prioritise the welfare, sustainability and ethical standards of journalists operating in the region.

results.title: GTEC intervenes in Savannah College dispute over payroll, governance
results.content: The Ghana Tertiary Education Commission (GTEC) has summoned stakeholders in the ongoing strike at the Savannah College of Education (SAVCE) for a meeting aimed at resolving the dispute, which has disrupted academic activities and left students without food for seven days and counting.

results.title: GPL 2026/27: 10-man Karela United hold Young Apostles in Wenchi

results.title: NAIMOS arrests 13 suspected illegal miners in raid on Offin River
results.content: The National Anti-Illegal Mining Operations Secretariat (NAIMOS) has raided a large illegal mining site at Subin Akwaaboso in the Upper Denkyira West District of the Central Region, arresting several 13 illegal miners operating on the Offin River.

results.title: Samartex edge Gold Stars to strengthen title credentials in Western derby

results.title: Cambridge scientist dies in Spanish train crash

results.title: NIA Taskforce launches nationwide crackdown on Ghana card photocopying from November 2
